name: Bitbucket
summary: Bitbucket Cloud hosts Git repositories with pull requests and branch permissions. The Free plan covers up to 5 users. Standard costs $3.65 per user a month and Premium $8. Merge checks only block a merge on Premium.

facts.text: Branch permissions control which users or groups can write to or merge into a branch, by branch name pattern or branch type.
Merge checks for minimum approvals, successful builds and unresolved tasks are available on every plan. Without Premium they only warn, and the pull request can still be merged.
Premium adds enforced merge checks, IP allowlisting, deployment permissions and required two-step verification.
The Free plan is for up to 5 users and includes unlimited public and private repositories, 1 GB of LFS storage and 50 build minutes.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited public and private repositories, 1 GB LFS storage, 50 build minutes

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Per user per month. Admins can switch between Standard and Premium at any time

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per user per month. Adds enforced merge checks, IP allowlisting, deployment permissions and required two-step verification

hiddenCosts: Blocking a merge until checks pass needs Premium.
1,000 extra build minutes or 100 GB of LFS storage cost $10 a month.
The pricing page shows dollar figures without naming a currency.
